solar_pv.source: NREL 2024, NREL/TP-7A40-87372, Table B5, imported weighted-average supply chain
solar_pv.basis: Sum of manufacture, BOS and installation rows: 1+59+230+100+18+68+220+130+38+30+13 = 1007 kg CO2e/kWdc. Excludes Use/O&M and EOL rows. Convert modeled MWac using the same ATB DC/AC ratio as the bill of materials. A reference silicon PV system, not a supplier declaration.

onshore_wind.source: NREL 2021 lifecycle factors, EF_Table_FINAL.xlsx, Land-based wind, one-time upstream median (cell E32)
onshore_wind.basis: 11 g CO2e/kWh one-time upstream median converted using an illustrative reference 35% capacity factor and 20-year life: 11 × 8760 × 0.35 × 20 / 1000 = 674.52 kg/kW. This conversion is an assumption, not an observed capacity footprint. Independent of this scenario's weather and dispatch.

battery.source: NREL 2021 lifecycle factors, EF_Table_FINAL.xlsx, Li-Ion Battery Storage, one-time upstream median (cell E60)
battery.basis: 31.547370412125535 g CO2e/kWh discharged converted using an illustrative reference 365 equivalent full discharge cycles/year for 15 years: factor × 365 × 15 / 1000 = 172.72 kg/kWh capacity. A screening conversion, not chemistry- or supplier-specific. Charging electricity is excluded here and counted in the hourly operational model.
